race.comment: TACITLY (3) is a genuine type who comes back in trip and finds a winnable contest. Motored late from the outside gate when second over 1850m at Newcastle. Looks to get the ideal run and sure to be thereabouts. BRADFORD (1) slashing return for the new yard when he cleared out for a dominant Maiden win over 1400m at this track. Should be even stronger over the mile and maps well. TASMAN DEEL (9) was narrowly beaten last time when well in commission over 1615m at Taree, finishing just a head from the winner in second. Key runner. KENISIS (12) settled back last start then made a sustained run to finish third over 1400m at this track. Will appreciate the extra ground this time and is worth consideration.
